faq.title: Straight answers
faq.1q: What do you need from me?
faq.1a1: For a Snapshot: your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry. For a Crier Deck: your business name and address, and the language you want the deck in. For a monthly plan: the same details, and we email you a payment link.
faq.1a2: For the posts in your Snapshot, it helps if you send your logo, your brand colors if you have them, and your own photos. We don't use stock photos of strangers in your posts.
faq.2q: What do I do with the fixes?
faq.2a1: They are written out so you can paste them in, or hand them to whoever looks after your website. The posts are files for you to use. Nothing is published for you.
faq.4q: Who owns what you make for me?
faq.4a1: The deck files, posts and captions we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours, and we do not show a Crier Deck made for you in public without your written OK.
faq.5a1: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. The Snapshot shows where you stand and what to fix first, with one fix explained step by step and three posts. Results depend on your business, your market and what you do with them.
faq.7q: Which languages do you work in?
faq.7a1: This site is in English, Spanish, French and Arabic, and you can write to us in any of them. A Crier Deck can be made in English, Spanish, French or Arabic, or in Arabic and English together.
faq.9a1: We use them to prepare what you asked for and email you about it. You can ask us to export or delete them any time at {email}. See the privacy policy for the details.

terms.intro: The terms for using crierstudio.com, the Snapshot, Crier Deck, the monthly plans and the client portal.
terms.who.p: Crier Studio is not yet a registered company. Contact is by email only: {email}.
terms.offer.p1: Snapshot ($29, one-time): three findings with proof from your own website or profile, one fix explained step by step, and three posts in your brand made from your own photos.
terms.offer.p2: Crier Deck ($149) and Crier Deck + Print Kit ($249), one-time: a brand deck made from your public pages, with your existing logo, for up to 11 products, delivered as a screen PDF in your client portal (1 revision round). The Print Kit adds the print-ready PDF and 2 revision rounds. What each includes is listed on the Crier Deck page. There is no preview before you order.
terms.nopromise.p: We do not promise more customers, more sales, a search ranking or any other result. What we deliver is the review, the written fix and the posts described above. What happens next depends on your business, your market and what you do with them.
terms.need.p: Accurate details, and only photos, logos and text you have the right to use. Nothing is published for you: you decide what to use.
terms.public.p: We review your site and profiles and, for comparisons, public information about similar businesses. If we cannot find comparable businesses we say so. Numbers come from public sources and can be incomplete or out of date.
terms.own.h: Ownership of what we make for you
terms.own.p: The deck files, posts and captions we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours. We do not show a Crier Deck made for you in public, as a sample or anywhere else, without your written OK. The samples on this site are made for fictional businesses.
terms.refund.p: If you are not happy with what we deliver, tell us and we will agree a fix or a refund with you in writing. See the refund policy.
terms.limits.p: We provide our services as described on this site. We do our best to be accurate, but public information we rely on can be incomplete or out of date, so check a deck or a post before you print or publish it. Questions about these terms: {email}.
privacy.intro: What Crier Studio collects when you ask for a Snapshot or a Crier Deck on crierstudio.com or use the client portal, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and how to export or erase it.
privacy.collect.p1: When you fill in the form we collect what you type: your business name, your website or Instagram handle, your email address, your city and your industry. For a Crier Deck we also collect your business address and the language you want the deck in. We record the language of the page you used, that you ticked the box agreeing to the use below, and the time you did.
privacy.collect.p2: To limit abuse, the form's server briefly uses your connection's address to count requests. It is kept only as a scrambled value in memory for up to an hour and is not saved with your details. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies on this site.
privacy.why.p: To prepare your Snapshot or Crier Deck, to run your client portal account if you have one, and to email you about what you asked for. We do not email you anything you did not ask for, and we do not sell your details.
privacy.who.p: Crier Studio (not yet a registered company) and the people who prepare Snapshots and Crier Decks for it. We use five service providers. Railway hosts the client portal and our records system. GitHub Pages hosts this site. Cloudflare handles the domain and, if we switch it on, Cloudflare Web Analytics, a visit counter that does not use cookies. Proton handles our email. Stripe processes payments: you enter your card details on Stripe's own payment page, so we never see or store your full card number, and Stripe tells us your name, your email address, what you bought, the amount and whether the payment went through. The hosts and Cloudflare may see ordinary visit data such as the page viewed and the address of your connection. We do not share your details with anyone else unless the law requires it.
privacy.keep.p: We keep your form details for up to 12 months after our last contact with you, then delete them. Client portal data is kept while your account is open and until you ask us to erase it.
privacy.del.p: Email {email} from the address you used. You can ask us for a copy of the details we hold about you, ask us to correct them, or ask us to erase them. We will send the copy, or confirm the erasure, by email.
privacy.changes.p: If we change this policy, the date above will change. We will not use your details in a new way without asking you first.
refund.once.p: You pay in US dollars through a secure payment link we email you. Nothing is charged until you use that link.
refund.snap.p: The Snapshot is a $29 one-time payment. If you are not happy with what we deliver, email us within 7 days and we will agree a fix or a refund with you in writing.
refund.ask.p: Email {email} with the business name you used.
